o.tf: Invitation à la présentation des résultats
o.t: Invitation to the presentation of Skanska's interim report third quarter 2026 on November 5
Skanska invests PLN 157M, about SEK 400M, in a residential development project in Kraków, Poland
Skanska divests rental multifamily project in Gothenburg, Sweden for about SEK 380M
Skanska to construct a new waterfront connection in New York, USA, for USD 163M, about SEK 1.5 billion
Skanska builds healthcare center in Egersund, Norway, for NOK 320M, about SEK 310M
Skanska to provide railroad improvements in northeast USA for USD 136M, about SEK 1.3 billion
Skanska signs additional contract for construction of tech facility in USA for USD 138M, about SEK 1.3 billion
Skanska signs contract amendment for education project in Western USA for USD 78M, about SEK 730M
Skanska to construct new high school in Renton, Washington, USA for USD 110M, about SEK 1.0 billion
Skanska signs additional contract for new hospital in Fort Myers, Florida, USA, for USD 60M, about SEK 560M
Skanska to replace U.S. Coast Guard Homeport Pier in Rhode Island, USA, for USD 271M, about SEK 2.5 billion
Skanska to build and renovate academic buildings in Fredericksburg, USA, for USD 163M, about SEK 1.5 billion
Skanska invests CZK 1.5 billion, about SEK 660M, in a new phase of a residential project in Prague, Czech Republic
